vehicle.name: Tradie Ute
vehicle.blurb: Heavy, torquey and tough. Hauls itself out of anything.

vehicle.name: Hawk Dash
vehicle.blurb: Rear-drive V8 with twin stripes. Punch it and the tail steps out.

vehicle.name: Lion President
vehicle.blurb: The Hawk's old rival: the same V8 and the same grunt under a different body.

vehicle.name: AU Hawk
vehicle.blurb: Big round family sedan with a big grin. Loves a burnout and a doughnut, and it is a touch slower.

vehicle.name: Postie Bike
vehicle.blurb: Nippy step-through with a full mail run on the back. Gets everywhere, eventually.

vehicle.name: Pig Catcher
vehicle.blurb: Tall, light and hungry for air. Wheelies on request.
